from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def test():
    try:
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            page = await browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1200, 'height': 900})

                await page.screenshot(path='test_screenshot2.png', full_page=True)
                await browser.close()
                print('鎴浘鎴愬姛')
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'鎴浘澶辫触: type={type(e).__name__}, repr={repr(e)}')
            import traceback
            traceback.print_exc()
    
    await capture()

asyncio.run(outer())

import sys, subprocess, os

# 妯℃嫙 _run_screenshot_subprocess 鐨勯€昏緫
full_url = 'http://localhost:8001/ui/res_module/index.html'
save_path = os.path.abspath('./web/screenshots/test_verify.png')
timeout = 15
viewport_width = 1200
viewport_height = 900

script = f'''
import sys
try:
    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={{\"width\": {viewport_width}, \"height\": {viewport_height}}})
        page.goto(\"{full_url}\", wait_until=\"networkidle\", timeout={timeout * 1000})
        page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        page.screenshot(path=r\"{save_path}\", full_page=True)
        browser.close()
    print(\"OK\")
except Exception as e:
    print(f\"ERROR: {{type(e).__name__}}: {{e}}\", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
'''

proc = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, '-c', script],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    timeout=timeout + 15
)

print(f'returncode: {proc.returncode}')
print(f'stdout: {proc.stdout.strip()}')
print(f'stderr: {proc.stderr.strip()}')
print(f'file exists: {os.path.exists(save_path)}')
if os.path.exists(save_path):
    print(f'file size: {os.path.getsize(save_path)} bytes')

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1200, 'height': 900})
    page.goto('http://localhost:8000/ui/res_module/index.html?_t=1770725865679', wait_until='load', timeout=15000)
    
    # 妫€鏌ュ湴鍥� canvas 鏄惁瀛樺湪
    try:
        page.wait_for_selector('#viewDiv canvas', timeout=10000)
        print('canvas found')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'canvas not found: {e}')
    
    # 妫€鏌� viewDiv 鍐呭
    content = page.evaluate('document.querySelector(\"#viewDiv\").innerHTML.substring(0, 500)')
    print(f'viewDiv content: {content[:300]}')
    
    # 妫€鏌ユ帶鍒跺彴閿欒
    errors = []
    page.on('console', lambda msg: errors.append(msg.text) if msg.type == 'error' else None)
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    
    # 鍐嶆妫€鏌�
    canvas_count = page.evaluate('document.querySelectorAll(\"#viewDiv canvas\").length')
    print(f'canvas count: {canvas_count}')
    
    browser.close()

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    # 鍚敤 GPU/WebGL 鏀寔
    browser = p.chromium.launch(
        headless=True,
        args=['--enable-webgl', '--use-gl=swiftshader', '--enable-gpu-rasterization']
    )
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1200, 'height': 900})
    page.goto('http://localhost:8000/ui/res_module/index.html?_t=1770725865679', wait_until='load', timeout=15000)
    
    # 绛夊緟鍦板浘 canvas
    try:
        page.wait_for_selector('#viewDiv canvas', timeout=15000)
        print('canvas found!')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'canvas not found: {type(e).__name__}')
    
    canvas_count = page.evaluate('document.querySelectorAll(\"#viewDiv canvas\").length')
    print(f'canvas count: {canvas_count}')
    
    # 妫€鏌� WebGL 鏀寔
    webgl = page.evaluate('''() => {
        const c = document.createElement(\"canvas\");
        const gl = c.getContext(\"webgl\") || c.getContext(\"experimental-webgl\");
        return gl ? \"supported\" : \"not supported\";
    }''')
    print(f'WebGL: {webgl}')
    
    if canvas_count > 0:
        page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        page.screenshot(path='web/screenshots/test_with_map.png', full_page=True)
        import os
        print(f'screenshot size: {os.path.getsize(\"web/screenshots/test_with_map.png\")} bytes')
    
    browser.close()

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(
        headless=True,
        args=['--enable-webgl', '--use-gl=swiftshader']

    # 鏀堕泦鎺у埗鍙版秷鎭�

    page.wait_for_timeout(10000)
    
    print('=== Console errors ===')

        if 'error' in msg.lower() or 'fail' in msg.lower() or 'warn' in msg.lower():
            print(msg[:200])
    
    print('\\n=== Failed requests ===')
    for req in failed_requests:
        print(req[:200])
    
    browser.close()

import os

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(
        headless=True,
        args=['--disable-web-security', '--ignore-certificate-errors']
    )
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1200, 'height': 900})
    
    console_msgs = []
    page.on('console', lambda msg: console_msgs.append(f'[{msg.type}] {msg.text}'))
    
    page.goto('http://localhost:8000/ui/res_module/index.html?_t=1770725865679', wait_until='load', timeout=15000)
    
    try:
        page.wait_for_selector('#viewDiv canvas', timeout=15000)
        print('canvas found!')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'canvas not found: {type(e).__name__}')
    
    canvas_count = page.evaluate('document.querySelectorAll(\"#viewDiv canvas\").length')
    print(f'canvas count: {canvas_count}')
    
    page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    page.screenshot(path='web/screenshots/test_with_map3.png', full_page=True)

    # 妫€鏌ユ槸鍚﹁繕鏈夐敊璇�
    for msg in console_msgs:
        if 'error' in msg.lower() or 'fail' in msg.lower():

    browser.close()
